messages:
maria: Quick design pass on streaming playground — attaching new mocks. Main issues: ambiguous stop/pause behavior, token counter prominence, and prompt library peek pushing the stream offscreen. figma: https://figma.com/file/playground-stream-updates
sam: Thanks. Which two fixes should we prioritize for beta?
maria: 1) clarify stop vs pause semantics + copy, 2) reduce token counter visual weight during active streaming.
alex: Dev note: Stop is currently wired to a hard interrupt. Pause is a soft hold/resume. We need distinct API hooks if UI shows both. I can implement, but need clear copy & state transitions.
aria: Accessibility: streaming area needs aria-live="polite". Token counter must not be an extra live region or it will be noisy for screen reader users. Also Stop needs an accessible name explaining destructiveness, e.g., "Stop generation — discard partial output".
maria: Copy proposals: option A: primary (red) "Stop" with tooltip "Discard current output"; secondary (neutral) "Pause" tooltip "Pause streaming, resume later". Option B: explicit labels "Stop and discard" / "Pause and resume". Thoughts?
sam: Lean A for visual brevity; tooltips cover extra detail. We can test labels in the A/B.
alex: For Stop being destructive, we should avoid blocking modals on mobile. Suggest an undo toast: "Generation stopped. Undo" (5s). Also log undo events.
aria: Good — toast must get focus when announced and include an accessible undo button. Ensure keyboard users can reach it.
maria: Token counter placement ideas: inline low-density below prompt, or floating pill over the stream. My preference is inline for initial rollout with a settings toggle to enable the pill for power users.
sam: Agree — default low-density, user-toggle for pill. We'll collect toggle usage.
alex: Technical: debounce token updates to once per second to avoid jank. Also expose an endpoint for toggling pill server-side so settings persist.
aria: Contrast check: floating pill currently fails AA at 12px. If we show the pill, bump size to 14px and use darker text or semi-opaque backdrop.
maria: Prompt library peek currently opens as a drawer that scrolls the conversation away. Suggest non-blocking rail or split view so live stream controls stay visible. On narrow screens, use overlay.
alex: I'll implement responsive behavior: split on >= 1024px, overlay otherwise. That keeps complexity manageable.
sam: Can we A/B overlay vs split to see if users keep the stream visible more often? Metric angles: regenerate frequency, stop/pause ratio, prompt opens during stream.
maria: Yes — plan an A/B for two weeks. We'll measure those metrics plus token toggle adoption.
aria: Accessibility checklist for the experiment: keyboard focus order for stop/pause, aria-live behavior for stream and toast, announcement when prompt library opens but stream continues, and contrast checks for token pill.
deploy-bot: Branch 'playground/stream-ux-experiment' created with basic copy changes, aria attributes, and debounce logic. CI green.
maria: I'll update Figma with toast and tooltip states and create the copy variants for the A/B. Assign follow-ups: @alex implement toggles+undo toast+debounce, @aria own a11y test script, @sam define metrics and dashboard.
sam: I'll add analytics events and dashboard slices. ETA by next Wednesday. :thumbsup:
alex: I'll open the PR and include screenshots for responsive states.
aria: I'll run automated axe checks and manual NVDA passes on the branch once available.
maria: Great work — small changes but should improve clarity for end users. :sparkles:
